newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chevron unit secures China onshore oil deal.
newsitem.headline: Chevron unit secures China onshore oil deal.

text.p: Chevron Overseas Petroleum Ltd, a unit of Chevron Corp., said Friday it secured an onshore oil production-sharing contract with China's main oil producer, China National Petroleum Corp.
The deal, Chevron's first onshore oil exploration contract in China, is for a 695 square mile (1,800 square km) land tract in the Shengli Field Complex in China's Shandong province, it said.
The Shengli Field Complex is the second-largest oil field in China, with daily production of some 650,000 barrels of crude.
Chevron will evaluate geologic data previously gathered in the tract, plan drilling programmes and operate the tract. It has 100 percent interest in the project during the exploration phase.
